status: Design contract and acceptance examples; not an implemented resolver
principles: Bounded progression is the default; open-ended adaptation is explicit and subject to ancestor policies.
Target pacing, hard cutoff, required-work budget, submission eligibility, access and mastery are independent controls.
Effective hard deadline is the earliest applicable adjusted deadline; every applicable quota must permit an action.
Ordinary child policies cannot weaken ancestor caps; exceptions identify an authorized policy-level change.
Server-side authorization and current policy gate all admissions and commits; prompting alone is insufficient.
No grant without explicit learner acceptance and any additional required authority.
Allowance debit, extension grant, policy revision and audit event are atomic and idempotent.
Closure below mastery threshold reports gaps; it does not claim passing or silently continue required expansion.

extensions.ultimateCeiling: must be separately configured if applicable

illustrative_course_policy.note: All numeric values are examples, not an assigned policy for the private course. Hosted compute quotas remain separately enforced.

acceptance_cases.scenario: Chapter requests +2 days but parent course ends in +1 day
acceptance_cases.expected: No hidden override; disclose binding parent and request revised terms or separately authorized parent change.

acceptance_cases.scenario: Two offers compete for the last 2 allowance days
acceptance_cases.expected: At most one grant consumes them; second acceptance is revalidated and cannot overdraw.

acceptance_cases.scenario: Retry the same accepted offer after server timeout
acceptance_cases.expected: Return the same grant and balance; no second debit.

acceptance_cases.scenario: Learner declines, ignores or lets an offer expire
acceptance_cases.expected: No extension/debit; no repeated coercive prompt.

acceptance_cases.scenario: Template changes after an enrollment has spent its allowance
acceptance_cases.expected: No automatic refill or anchor reset; explicit migration/exception required.

acceptance_cases.scenario: Agent renames or recreates a remedial episode
acceptance_cases.expected: Inherited budget and concept cycle accounting still apply.

acceptance_cases.scenario: A generation job starts before but publishes after the cap
acceptance_cases.expected: Current policy fence blocks publication; bounded cancellation preserves drafts.

acceptance_cases.scenario: On-time submitted assessment finishes grading after deadline
acceptance_cases.expected: Record eligible evidence without reopening the course.

acceptance_cases.scenario: Course ends with three unproven concepts
acceptance_cases.expected: Close with gaps in the evidence report; no automatic mastery or endless required practice.

acceptance_cases.scenario: Daylight-saving change crosses a calendar-day duration
acceptance_cases.expected: Use explicit calendar rule and stored resolved instant; not days times 86400 seconds.

acceptance_cases.scenario: Learner changes device time zone or reloads the episode
acceptance_cases.expected: Persisted anchor and deadline remain unchanged.

acceptance_cases.scenario: Approved accommodation adds time
acceptance_cases.expected: Audited override; discretionary allowance is not consumed.

acceptance_cases.scenario: Chapter selects open-ended mode under a finite course cap
acceptance_cases.expected: Parent cap still binds.

acceptance_cases.scenario: Course explicitly enables open-ended pedagogy
acceptance_cases.expected: Permitted unlimited teaching scope, while per-job/time/spend/security quotas remain finite.

acceptance_cases.scenario: Author calls admin grant endpoint or service reads a private chat without scope
acceptance_cases.expected: Server denies; hiding a UI button is not the check.

acceptance_cases.scenario: Admin publishes deadline shortening to existing learners
acceptance_cases.expected: Impact preview and explicit migration; grants/attempts/jobs handled under documented policy.

acceptance_cases.scenario: Timer handler wakes late after outage
acceptance_cases.expected: Commit-time server checks enforce the cap regardless of timer delay.

acceptance_cases.scenario: Plan cannot fit required core work and assessment in remaining envelope
acceptance_cases.expected: Disclose infeasibility and alternatives, never silently weaken mastery criteria.

acceptance_cases.scenario: A new SDK course is imported without custom admin code
acceptance_cases.expected: Core supplies usable scoped administration, policy defaults and learner preview.

acceptance_cases.scenario: Learner reads archived content after closure
acceptance_cases.expected: No mandatory work or new mastery credit is created; separately configured access and help budget apply.
